notes: ScaleSmiths is modelled as a first-class business entity in the World Model (WORLD_MODEL.md §1). This adapter is how JARVIS acts on its behalf. It crosses a trust boundary to external ScaleSmiths systems with its own scoped credentials, distinct from every other adapter's. Concrete actions are defined as the integration surface is built out (ROADMAP.md MK.50).

actions.name: read_business_state
sideEffects: reads ScaleSmiths operational state via a scoped integration credential

actions.name: apply_operational_change
sideEffects: mutates ScaleSmiths business systems; dual control + simulate-first
